body:
[A10] Found by processor #69 lane round 2 (A550, PR #165 HANDOFF Notes). It predates #69 and is not changed by it.

At one AVB interface, `KL_aecp_notify` can lose a command's availability-probe cancel. A TIME_LIMITED drain's cancel and a command's cancel can fall in the same cycle; the single cancel path sends the drain's and drops the command's. The superseded exchange then stays in the originator's in-flight table, and its later failure can remove a live controller's registry row.

At two interfaces, #69 round 2 sends both (cancel-pending bits, drained one per cycle; check CA1b).

**Acceptance:**
1. At count 1, both cancels are sent: reuse #69's cancel-pending drain, or prove the command's cancel cannot coincide with a drain.
2. A pp_top / aecp_notify check of the same-cycle case, with a planted control that drops the second cancel.
3. OOC 1x1 delta within 20 LUT / 20 FF. Every arm still plants.

Relates to #69.
title: aecp_notify: a command's probe cancel is lost when a TIME_LIMITED drain cancels in the same cycle (count 1)
